text:
maya: heads up — noticed weird provisional credits on the console after a stream reconnect from a customer. looks like a short toolcall got truncated, retried, and we ended up showing both partial stream tokens and a separate toolcall charge :confused:

alex: can you paste the console screenshot or the trace id?

maya: trace=tr_20260314_81a9, screenshot sent in thread (sensitive redacted). TL;DR: console shows ~120 tokens from stream + a 30-token toolcall credit; ledger shows only 120 final settled tokens. users are confused.

billing-bot: ALERT: provisional_charge spike for customer_id=acme-42 at 2026-03-14T15:12:05Z (session tr_20260314_81a9)

sam: my guess: client opened stream, server sent prefix chunk, client disconnected mid-chunk, we retried the toolcall path and emitted a truncated toolcall event. console provisional logic double-counts stream-prefix + toolcall when truncation flag present.

toni: is this the same as the early-eof / prefetch overlap we saw? or new?

alex: similar surface but different trigger. prefetch was background embed load; here the active toolcall got switched to a fallback path because request routed to a cheaper replica during reconnect. routing policy did a model-variant swap and the toolcall TTL kicked in. we emitted both events: STREAM_CHUNK(partial=true) and TOOLCALL_INVOCATION(truncated=true) with separate provisional credits.

maya: here's the raw event payload (sanitized):
```json
{"session_id":"tr_20260314_81a9","events":[{"type":"stream_chunk","prefix_len":48,"tokens":60,"partial":true,"timestamp":"2026-03-14T15:11:58Z"},{"type":"toolcall","tool":"openapi","tokens":30,"truncated":true,"retry":true,"timestamp":"2026-03-14T15:12:01Z"},{"type":"final_settle","tokens":120,"timestamp":"2026-03-14T15:12:04Z"}]}
```

sam: that payload is exactly the problem. provisional console display sums provisional tokens across events in session without applying a dedupe rule for overlapping token ranges or a precedence rule (final_settle should win).

toni: simple fix in console: when rendering provisional totals, apply event precedence: FINAL_SETTLE > TOOLCALL > STREAM_CHUNK for overlapping token windows. But need to be careful with telemetry: we still want to surface all events for debugging.

alex: agree. two changes: 1) console UX should show provisional_total but also show "dedupe_adjustments" with a one-line rationale. 2) backend provisional aggregator should emit a canonical provisional delta per session so console doesn't guess.

maya: backend change might be bigger. how risky is emitting canonical provisional delta? could affect other dashboards and alerts.

sam: we can do a low-risk approach: add a provisional_canonical field on the session or event, computed by the ledger service in a backwards-compatible way (new field only). Console will prefer it if present. Otherwise fallback to current sum.

toni: +1. also add a small telemetry tag: "routing_variant_swap":true on the event so we can query how often route-fallback causes this.

alex: I'll own a tiny UX change for the console: hide the double-count behind an info-pill and add a tooltip "we're showing provisional totals — final settled values may differ". Backfill chat notes for CS.

maya: action items: alex -> console tooltip + dedupe view; sam -> ledger emit provisional_canonical field (opt-in flag); toni -> add telemetry tag for routing swaps; maya -> customer comms. I'll file a short RFC for the ledger opt-in.

alex: timeline? can we do low-risk console change today and ledger opt-in next week?

sam: yes I can ship opt-in within one week if nobody objects. low-risk flag will be off by default; enable for a handful of customers for testing.

toni: I'll add a dashboard tile to show sessions where provisional_total != provisional_canonical once sam ships it.

maya: perfect. thanks all. :thumbsup:

billing-bot: NOTE: follow-up ticket created #BI-6789 (provisional_dedupe-console)

alex: ping @sam for the RFC link when it's ready.

sam: will share RFC in #eng-platform.

maya: closing the loop here, leaving open for updates.
